title: Authoring ExecutionPlan 0.1.0
description: marea API v2 registration request body: the complete, self-contained Authoring ExecutionPlan. POST /v1/workflow-versions carries exactly this object, no wrapper, no query parameters. The outer structure is strict (unknown fields are rejected 400 invalid_json); an operator's K8s resource is carried either flat (operator_type + api_version + spec) or as a complete manifest (apiVersion/kind/metadata/spec) — exactly one of the two (both or neither → 422 schema_violation). Either way the spec is validated against the supported Pod/v1 subset (see pod-spec-0.1.0.json) and unsupported-but-legal content is rejected 422 schema_violation.

business_type.description: Immutable business classification; omitted/empty means unclassified.

template_type.description: Immutable user-defined template category; unrelated to Pod kind.

artifact_contract.description: Opt in to metadata-only path registration; omitted preserves legacy behavior.

root_dag_version_id.description: Exact, immutable publish identity of the entry DAG. Natural key part 1.

dag_definitions.description: Exactly one entry whose dag_version_id == root_dag_version_id. Nested DAGs are out of scope (422).

operator_definitions.description: Operator version library; every node's target_version_id must resolve here (reference closure). Each entry uses one of the two mutually exclusive resource forms (flat / manifest).

path.description: Either legacy stage_run_id prefix or run_id/stage_name/attempt/eviction_count prefix, followed by one JSON filename.

dag_id.description: Stable cross-version DAG identity (not executable alone).

inputs.description: DAG-level run inputs. input_id is the stable binding identity; name is the run-submission key.

name.description: Unique within the DAG; the run inputs key.

type.description: Run-input type. int never accepts a bool; float accepts finite numbers; list[T] validates each element.

default.description: Literal default applied when the submission omits the input.

outputs.description: DAG-level outputs; each must be bound in output_bindings.

nodes.description: Flat operator nodes. Only kind 'operator' is supported. May be empty ONLY for a zero-stage passthrough DAG: at least one output, all outputs dag_input bindings (422 otherwise).

output_bindings.description: Key = dag output name (must be declared in outputs[]); value is one of two binding kinds: node_output (mirrors a node's output port) or dag_input (passes a DAG input straight through as the output).

output.description: Must be a declared output port of that node's operator.

input_id.description: References a DAG input id. Collapsed kinds (scalar/json) must match; exact scalar type conversion is not performed.

timeout.description: Stage timeout in seconds. Overrides operator execution.timeout; capped by creation-time executor_feedback_timeout and the original workflow timeout, if provided. Omitted/null inherits.

definition_node_id.description: Unique node identity; echoed by stages/events queries.

name.description: Unique stage name derived from the node.

kind.description: Nested DAG ('dag') is out of scope (422).

input_bindings.description: Key = the target operator's input port name. Exactly one source form per port (I2).

input_id.description: Must reference a dag input id.

node_id.description: Must reference another node; the only binding kind that derives a DAG edge.

output.description: Must be a declared output port of that node's operator.

value.description: Fixed value pinned at registration; no DAG edge.

operatorDefinition.description: One operator version. The K8s resource is carried in exactly ONE of two mutually exclusive forms: the flat triple (operator_type + api_version + spec) or manifest (apiVersion/kind/metadata/spec). Both forms present, or neither, → 422 schema_violation. The manifest form is normalized into the flat form before the registration digest, so the two forms of the same content seal one version (same natural key + same digest → 200 replay).

envFromDefaults.description: Common operator sources; container envFrom and per-container task_params.pod_spec_patch envFrom append in increasing priority order.

operator_version_id.description: Unique across operator_definitions; the target of node target_version_id.

resource_pool.description: Required non-blank operator execution pool, copied to the immutable execution template as resource_pool. Missing/null/blank values return 422 resource_pool_required. L2 snapshots task_params.resource_pool when supplied, otherwise this default; execution-side routing must consume it.

operator_type.description: K8s/CRD original kind, case-sensitive. Future: TrainJob, RayJob (same exact-kind rule).

spec.description: Supported Pod v1 spec interior, including native sidecars, volumes, mounts and scheduling fields. Unknown fields are rejected.

timeout.description: Default stage timeout in seconds. Node timeout overrides this value. Omitted/null uses the existing configured fallback.

retryLimit.description: Authoring additional retry count, mapped directly to stage max_retry. 0 runs once without retry; 1 permits one retry (at most two executions). Default 0 when neither retry field is set; mutually exclusive with maxRetry.

maxRetry.description: Additional retries after the first execution. New runs default to zero; cannot be combined with retryLimit.

metadata.description: Normalized labels/annotations from manifest.metadata, accepted on export replay. Cannot be combined with manifest. Annotation keys and values have a combined 256 KiB UTF-8 byte limit enforced by the server (422 on excess).

operatorDefinitionManifest.description: Manifest form: the complete Kubernetes resource replaces operator_type/api_version/spec. Normalization: operator_type ← manifest.kind, api_version ← manifest.apiVersion, spec ← manifest.spec.

envFromDefaults.description: Common operator sources; container envFrom and per-container task_params.pod_spec_patch envFrom append in increasing priority order.

operator_version_id.description: Unique across operator_definitions; the target of node target_version_id.

resource_pool.description: Required non-blank operator execution pool, copied to the immutable execution template as resource_pool. Missing/null/blank values return 422 resource_pool_required. L2 snapshots task_params.resource_pool when supplied, otherwise this default; execution-side routing must consume it.

kind.description: Case-sensitive exact kind; anything else → 422 unsupported_kind.

name.description: Must equal operator_definitions[].name (422 schema_violation otherwise). Dropped at normalization (redundant), so it never affects the digest.

annotations.description: Total size (sum of key+value bytes) must be ≤ 256 KiB, matching the Authoring-side limit; over → 422 schema_violation.

spec.description: Same supported Pod/v1 subset as the flat form's spec (pod-spec-0.1.0.json); unsupported keys → 422 schema_violation with field path operator_definitions[i].manifest.spec.<key>.

timeout.description: Default stage timeout in seconds. Node timeout overrides this value. Omitted/null uses the existing configured fallback.

retryLimit.description: Authoring additional retry count, mapped directly to stage max_retry. 0 runs once without retry; 1 permits one retry (at most two executions). Default 0 when neither retry field is set; mutually exclusive with maxRetry.

maxRetry.description: Additional retries after the first execution. New runs default to zero; cannot be combined with retryLimit.
